patterns.note: Full-width video hero section with overlaid text and calls to action, setting an immersive tone immediately.
Alternating background colors (white and a light, warm beige) are used for distinct content sections to visually break up the page.
The main navigation bar is sticky, initially transparent over the hero video, and then transitions to an opaque background with a subtle shadow as the user scrolls down.
Content sections and their internal elements (headings, text blocks, images) are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
A prominent, persistent full-screen overlay popup for lead capture appears immediately on page load and remains visible across all scroll depths until explicitly closed by the user.

A vibrant, warm yellow is consistently used as a primary accent color for calls to action, interactive elements, and key highlights, providing energetic contrast to the otherwise neutral and earthy palette.

technique_notes: A full-bleed background video plays on loop in the hero section, serving as an engaging visual backdrop for overlaid text and calls to action.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements like headings, body text, and images fade up or slide in as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience.

The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, initially transparent over the hero, and then adopts a solid background color and subtle shadow after a short scroll distance to maintain readability and prominence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller uppercase labels and highly readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) is applied consistently to buttons, cards, and the persistent popup, creating a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while maintaining a comfortable density for feature grids and text blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the immediate and persistent full-screen overlay popup that remains visible throughout the entire page scroll, an unusually aggressive yet integrated lead capture strategy. This, combined with the seamless integration of the product into real-life, aspirational settings through high-quality video and photography, makes the site feel both direct and engaging.
